messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
ASH VAULT
You enter the company complex
The company complex is dim
You see the power cable
You see the CEO android replica duo offline
The CEO android replica duo are offline
The CEO android replica duo guard the trove
The trove is the vault
The trove holds old war techs
You can use the power cable
The power cable can start the CEO android replica duo
Now the CEO android replica duo release the techs
You can claim the techs
No human can release the techs
